🐀 Food Stock

Track frozen feeders. Stock goes down when you log a feed with a prey size.

Current stock

Prey size guide (ball python)

Rule of thumb: prey ≈ 10–15% of body weight (growers) or ~7–10% (adults), and about the width of the snake’s mid-body.

Storage: Data is saved in IndexedDB (large limit on iPhone) and photos are compressed automatically. Export a backup before clearing Safari data, updating iOS, or switching phones.

App settings

Simple on/off for feed alerts and one sound for every alert.

Feed / stock food alerts
Show “due to feed” and low-stock warnings on the dashboard.
Alert sound
One switch for all alert sounds (feed, hatch, stock). Off = silent.
Min feeds before sale
Breeder standard: hatchlings usually need several successful meals (often 3+) before sale.

Language

Choose app language. Genetics terms stay in English.

Hatch day notifications

For a reliable phone alarm, use Add Alarm to Calendar on a clutch (recommended on iPhone).

Optional: allow in-app banners when you open the app on hatch day.

Full backup

Snakes, photos, care history, pairings, clutches.

Restore backup

CSV import / export

Export your list to a spreadsheet, edit it, then import it back.

Columns: Name, Sex, Genes, Hets, Status, Weight_g, DOB, Location, Sire, Dam, Notes, FeedDays, Price

Import adds new snakes or updates existing ones with the same Name.
